verdict.rationale: Elastic documents a one-line `start-local` Docker setup for local development or testing (elastic-docs-5, elastic-docs-17), which gives a disposable environment separate from production. A free 14-day serverless trial project (elastic-docs-8) offers a hosted throwaway option, and serverless projects are described as isolated (elastic-docs-34). However, none of this is framed as a dedicated sandbox, and nothing shows how to safely mirror or test against production-like data. Missing for 10: a first-class sandbox or staging environment feature, documented ways to clone or snapshot production data into a test environment safely, agent-oriented sandbox guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration.
